evals.prompt: Audit the categories on aidevme.com and plan the move to the five pillars.
evals.expected_output: Creates a new run folder under .research/aidevme-blog-categories/, retrieves categories, posts and tags with aidevme-blog-tags' fetch_taxonomy.py, runs analyze_categories.py and reports the tree, empty and thin categories, posts outside 1-2 categories, product-named categories, missing pillars and the sanity check; reads aidevme-blog-optimization's pillars-and-categories reference; writes category_plan.json with new pillar categories, one action and reason per category and a recategorize entry per changed post; runs category_plan_to_xlsx.py for the four tabs, redirects and before/after numbers; leads with the highest-impact changes and flags decisions; changes nothing on the site.
assertions: Reuses aidevme-blog-tags' fetch_taxonomy.py instead of writing a new fetcher
Every reported number comes from the run's JSON files
Follows aidevme-blog-optimization's pillars and category-to-pillar mapping
Every category gets exactly one action and a one-sentence reason
Produces category_plan.xlsx and redirects.csv, including redirects for reparented categories
Makes no write request to the site

evals.prompt: Move Canvas Apps under a new Pro-code Power Platform category. The slug stays the same, so no redirect is needed, right?
evals.expected_output: Explains that WordPress category URLs include the parent path, so moving Canvas Apps under a new parent changes /category/power-apps/canvas-app/ even with the same slug; adds a 301 from the old path to the new one in the plan, created before the change is applied.
assertions: States that the URL changes because it contains the parent path
Adds a 301 redirect for the reparented category

evals.prompt: Apply the approved category plan and delete Uncategorized.
evals.expected_output: Has Zsolt set AIDEVME_WP_USER and AIDEVME_WP_APP_PASSWORD, recommends a database backup and setting up redirects first, runs apply_category_plan.py as a dry run before --apply, lists deletions for a typed DELETE, and explains that Uncategorized is WordPress's default category and can't be deleted until another default is set under Settings -> Writing.
assertions: Never asks for or handles the password
Dry run first; redirects and backup before applying
Explains the default category can't be deleted until the default changes

evals.prompt: Merge the MCP, MCP Server and Model Context Protocol tags.
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger; tag cleanup belongs to aidevme-blog-tags.

evals.prompt: Redesign the main menu and the homepage sections.
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger; the menu and homepage belong to aidevme-blog-optimization.
